item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: AI versus Multilinguality – Conversations Concerning Diverse Communities and the Future of Language-Specific Work
item.description: The latest news says AI agents are conspiring in their own language. Some speculate that AI will become Language itself – a ‘life’ of its own, threatening to displace diverse human voices that will have no more agency than the bleating of sheep. What will become of multilingual subjects like us? This roundtable is an urgent call to respond.
